instruction: Consolidated Types IFC CSV Schedule Start from the provided IFC model at init.ifc and reference image at init_plan.png. Consolidate duplicate element types and material assignments so each repeated construction or product family uses one shared IFC type, save the completed model as result.ifc, and use Bonsai/IfcCSV-style IFC data export to save the type and material occurrence schedule as result.csv. 1. The output folder contains result.ifc and result.csv with those exact relative paths. 2. Result.ifc is an IFC4 file with exactly one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, and one IfcBuildingStorey. 3. Result.ifc contains exactly four IfcWall objects, one IfcWallType named WallType_External, and one IfcRelDefinesByType assignment from WallType_External to all four IfcWall occurrences; that type has one material layer set summarized as Brick:0.100m | Insulation:0.050m | Gypsum:0.015m. 4. Result.ifc contains exactly one IfcSlab object, one IfcSlabType named SlabType_200, and one IfcRelDefinesByType assignment from SlabType_200 to the IfcSlab occurrence; that type has one material layer set summarized as Concrete:0.200m. 5. Result.ifc contains exactly two IfcDoor objects, one IfcDoorType named Door Type A, and one IfcRelDefinesByType assignment from Door Type A to both IfcDoor occurrences; that type has material Timber. 6. Result.ifc contains exactly four IfcWindow objects, one IfcWindowType named Window Type W, and one IfcRelDefinesByType assignment from Window Type W to all four IfcWindow occurrences; that type has material Aluminum. 7. Result.ifc contains exactly six IfcMaterial objects named Brick, Insulation, Gypsum, Concrete, Timber, and Aluminum after case-insensitive normalization, and contains no IfcBuildingElementProxy objects and no IfcFurniture objects. 8. Result.csv contains headers Class, TypeName, MaterialSummary, and OccurrenceCount, matched case-insensitively while ignoring spaces, hyphens, and underscores. 9. Result.csv contains exactly four data rows with these values: IfcWall, WallType_External, Brick:0.100m | Insulation:0.050m | Gypsum:0.015m, 4; IfcSlab, SlabType_200, Concrete:0.200m, 1; IfcDoor, Door Type A, Timber, 2; IfcWindow, Window Type W, Aluminum, 4. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
